findings.finding: Covariance and finite polynomial identities overstated as unique nonlinear source and universal packet-force laws.
findings.resolution: Separate the supplied log-linear completion; nonzero-total torus obstruction and finite residence law; exact phase-force counterexample, fixed-rate similarity and independent conditional ray scope.

findings.finding: Energy conservation conflated with full variational necessity, two multipliers conflated, normalization and alternative-bond existence overstated.
findings.resolution: Canonical dynamics and sufficient field equations explicitly supplied; total-ledger multiplier corrected; gamma/6 and bump expansion corrected; grounded positive diagonal model, fixed-diagonal pair derivative, necessary alternative-bond mass bound only.

findings.finding: Flat dispersion, numerical support cones, unique formation odds and universal bending statements too broad; stiffness missing normalization.
findings.resolution: Separate common-mode constraint and reduced models, continuous tails versus numerical cone, arbitrary-initial-rate solution; target-site feasibility and centroid exceptions; acoustic stiffness /3, instantaneous zero-hop state and narrowly defined local ray comparison.

findings.finding: Field linearity extended to hopping ledger, generic static/propagation claims omit degeneracies and source placement.
findings.resolution: Mixed rate derivative proves nonlinear hopping; finite static convex model and constrained linear dynamics; rectangular commuting operators, structured equal-length source counterexample; nonzero nondegenerate tensor modes, finite-lattice anisotropy, quotient bound and missing site-to-face transfer explicit.

findings.finding: Exact current identities promoted to universal closure/field uniqueness/existence; conformal sign and continuum/lattice rotation conflated.
findings.resolution: Retain exact local identities and generic matrix-range statement; defer q-only numerical no-go; correct conformal sign; divergence compatibility is necessary, chosen continuum ansatz is not all lattice actions; explicit 12/125 uniform bond torque; first-order coin symmetry, exact covariant stress terms, distinct smooth force limit and curl-only lattice obstruction.

findings.finding: Static formation comparison claims universal nonzero jumps, instantaneous response, clock flux identification and unrestricted flux-preserving record existence.
findings.resolution: Distinguish flux of 1-N from leading clock coefficient P+Q; explicit example versus general expansion with possible zero coefficient; monotone bounded record flux requires S<1/(2g_yy); no dynamical formation claim.

findings.finding: Historical simulation and campaign certificates do not verify corrected canonical science.
findings.resolution: Fresh15 caches,15 consequential mutations and15 independent controls; explicit215 ancillary dispositions; all15 source branches preserved, no historical simulation or audit verdict adopted.
